Spanish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

    Inherited from Old Spanish fongo, from Latin fungus.

    Pronunciation

    [edit]
    • IPA(key): /ˈonɡo/ [ˈõŋ.ɡo]
    • Rhymes: -onɡo
    • Syllabification: hon‧go

    Noun

    [edit]

    hongo m (plural hongos)

    1. fungus
    2. bowler hat, derby
      Synonym: bombín
    3. (Latin America) mushroom
      Synonyms: (Chile) callampa, champiñón, seta
    4. globular buildup of carbon on the end of a wick
      Synonym: flor

    Derived terms

    [edit]
    • hongo bistec
    • hongo de repisa
    • hongos imperfectos
    • nube de hongo

    Further reading

    [edit]
    • “hongo”, in Diccionario de la lengua española [Dictionary of the Spanish Language] (in Spanish), online version 23.8.1, Royal Spanish Academy [Spanish: Real Academia Española], 15 December 2025

    Swahili

    [edit]

    Etymology

    [edit]

    From -honga (“to bribe”) +‎ -o.

    Pronunciation

    [edit]
    • Audio (Kenya):(file)

    Noun

    [edit]

    hongo class IX (plural hongo class X)

    1. bribe, tribute (payment exacted from someone)
      Synonyms: see Thesaurus:rushwa
